scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students

fields.instruction_en: Enter your full name as on school certificate.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna poora naam school certificate ke anusar likhein.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your SC caste certificate number.
fields.instruction_hi: Apna SC jaati praman patra number darj karein.

fields.instruction_en: Enter your family's total annual income in rupees.
fields.instruction_hi: Apne parivar ki kul varshik aay rupaye mein darj karein.

fields.instruction_en: Enter the name of the course you are enrolled in.
fields.instruction_hi: Apne course ka naam darj karein jisme aap enrolled hain.
